label: PF Backlog 587
title: EDP execution order was mis-sequenced: RLS (EDP-09) ordered before the schema/DAL (EDP-17) it depends on
body: CONCERN (RCCA). Symptom: the EDP dependency ledger ordered EDP-09 (tenant context + RLS) before EDP-17 (canonical PostgreSQL schema + DAL/CRUD + pooling), so the epic would attempt RLS on tables that do not exist yet - wrong execution order across waves. Root cause: EDP-17 was seeded blocked_by [1300,1301] and EDP-09 by [1296] only; the schema was never made a prerequisite of the isolation/data-plane items. Fix applied: corrected blocked_by across ALL EDP waves - schema-first (EDP-17<-EDP-08/1300), then EDP-09<-EDP-17, then data-plane services (EDP-07<-schema, EDP-10/11/12/13<-systems, EDP-14/15/16/18/19/20/21<-schema/objects). Secondary defect found: POST /items/{id}/dependencies silently DROPS a blocker edge (EDP-09<-EDP-17 never persists) - needs RCCA + guard. Correct order: W0 EDP-01/02/03/04/07/08(+06); W1 EDP-17,05,13; W2 EDP-09,10,14,11; W3 EDP-15,18,19,20,12; W4 EDP-21,16,23; W5 EDP-22; W6 EDP-24.
